svg.title: Drude model — electric drive, scattering and steady current
svg.desc: DC conductivity sigma0=ne squared tau/m*. A single teal curve shows J(t)/(sigma0 E0)=1-exp(-t/tau): the current density parallel to a uniform positive field switched on at time zero, starting from J(0)=0. A gold point marks 1-exp(-1), about 63 percent, at t=tau. The dashed line at one is the steady current. Low-field isotropic parabolic-band Drude response with constant carrier density, positive effective mass and transport relaxation time; this is not an individual electron trajectory.
svg.text: Constant n, m* and τ · E0 > 0 · J(0) = 0
